math_review: Every finite abelian diagonal quasi-free action on a simple purely infinite Cuntz-Krieger algebra associated with a finite essential 0-1 matrix is strongly approximately inner, with implementing unitaries in the fixed algebra of the whole action. This gives an affirmative deduction for the historical Question 1 in OWR2017/42, including periodic matrices, nonouter actions and nonfaithful actions. No approximate representation law is asserted.
priority_scope: This note is attributed exposition and complete explicit verification of known consequences of prior theorems, not a claim of a new solution or mechanism. The main deduction uses Gabe-Szabo, arXiv:2205.04933v1 (10 May 2022), Theorem 5.8, together with the established diagonal-coboundary mechanism, an explicitly normalized vertex inner kernel, an honest cocycle, and finite-group averaging with polar correction. The separate verification material also retains the original Barlak-Szabo 2019 route with explicit reductions removing its outerness and aperiodicity restrictions. Prior credit includes Izumi for the standard finite Cuntz case (inspected 2002 preprint, Proposition 5.6(2)), Matsumoto 2000 for diagonal coboundaries and periodic-point constraints, and Crisp-Gow for the periodic return corner (inspected 2004 v1, Theorem 3.1). The source audit also credits Christensen-Neagu-Szabo, arXiv:2504.12730v1/v2, for the prior strong-approximate-innerness duality framework, without attributing the combined full-target deduction as their printed statement. The inspected preprints and the final publication metadata are distinguished. No first solution, independent discovery, new mechanism, first explicit combined theorem or current worldwide openness is claimed. Priority for an older explicit complete combined statement remains unestablished; the full Zacharias chapter and final Izumi 2004 body were unavailable in the current source audit.
